# AI Engineer CLI (`aie`)

> Local harness CLI: the model selects tools; the harness owns permissions, budgets, and metadata sessions.

Install: `uv sync --all-extras` then `uv run aie`.
Python: 3.12+.
Default offline provider: `mock`. Live: `openrouter` or `openai`.
Human owns git commit and push. No arbitrary shell tool.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](quickstart.md): install, mock smoke, OpenRouter, watching stderr
- [CLI reference](cli.md): flags, env vars, tools, REPL, exit codes, sub-agent use
- [Architecture](architecture.md): control loop and package map
- [Security](security.md): trust model, permissions, env scrub, limits
- [Terminology](terminology.md): approved terms
